title: greatai Review: free AI + human code review for open source & nonprofits | greatai.dev
excerpt: Paste a public GitHub repo: a quick AI scan in a minute, then a full review by an Operum AI agent team on a live board, plus an optional human expert.
content_html:
greatai Review · Free Clinic for open source

Free code & architecture review for open source and nonprofits

Paste a public GitHub repository. One review, three stages: a quick AI scan in about a minute, then, for maintainers, an Operum AI team review you can watch live on a board, and an optional review by a vetted human expert.

1. Quick AI scan

About a minute, for anyone and any public repo. A quick AI pass over structure, risks, security smells and the five most valuable fixes.

2. Operum AI team review

For the repo's maintainers: a team of AI agents works through the repository, and you watch it live on a board. Sign in with GitHub to confirm you maintain the repo.

3. Human expert review

Optional, for maintainers: ask a vetted human expert to take a look. Human review slots are limited. Reviewers volunteer their time.

Results pages are unlisted: only people with the link can see them.
